status: Implemented; build, default and Worker validation passed
change: Count, sum, average, variance/stddev and min/max expose direct serialized byte measurements. Group accounting selects these after incremental growing-state accounting and before the legacy snapshot fallback. Measurements sum constant JSON syntax and existing serializedValueBytes scalar semantics, avoiding temporary fixed-state snapshot objects per row.

cases: Exact checkpoint byte cap succeeds and one byte less fails with the same actual size
Large finite and nonfinite numeric state
Escaped Unicode and lone-surrogate min/max values
Existing restored and growing aggregate serialized-size boundary tests

remaining: First/last/any still use snapshot fallback and can allocate scalar conversion temporaries.
Immutable group header is measured once but still uses a temporary key snapshot.
Growing-state size records and changed-value formatting still allocate runtime temporaries.
No wall-clock speedup is claimed from snapshot-object elimination alone.
